decoDesc.decoNote: Folios 1b and 2a form a fully illuminated, symmetrical double-page frontispiece set within multilayered geometric frames. Each page is organised around a large rectangular upper panel, a horizontal cartouche immediately below it and above the main text block, the text block itself, and a second horizontal cartouche beneath it.

Surmounting the text area is a large rectangular illuminated headpiece, enclosed within a system of minium and malachite-green rulings. At the centre of the headpiece is a prominent lobed ogival medallion in minium, set against a deep lapis lazuli blue ground and adorned with fine gold arabesque scrollwork. It is flanked along the inner vertical edges by two matching half-medallions of similar design and colour.

Along the bottom edge of the panel, the composition features a central upward-pointing cruciform half-medallion, flanked by two stylised, bird-like floral pendants above and two lobed quarter-medallions at the lower corners, all set against a deep lapis lazuli blue ground. Along the upper edge of the headpiece, a series of pointed, flame-like gold crests projects upwards into the unilluminated upper margin.

The upper horizontal cartouches serve as sūra headings and take the form of elongated rectangular panels with burnished gold-leaf grounds, flanked by gilt diamond-shaped spandrels at their outer edges. The right-hand cartouche contains the inscription سورة الفاتحة الکتاب سبع آية نزل مكیّه. The corresponding cartouche on the left contains the title and verse count of the following sūra: سورة البقره آیات ستّه و ثمانون آية مدینه. Both panels are enclosed by a narrow minium (vermilion) band along the upper edge and a delicate white-lead fretwork or meander band along the lower edge.

The central text block is arranged in horizontal registers delineated by fine rulings, with black calligraphic script executed within reserved, undulating, cloud-shaped outlines (cloud-band reserves) on the natural cream-coloured paper ground. An extensive field of burnished gold leaf surrounds these reserves and fills the entire rectangular text panel, occupying the interlinear spaces and margins around the script.

The lower horizontal cartouches are similarly elongated and rectangular, with gilt grounds and elaborate floral decoration. Each contains a calligraphic inscription at its centre, surrounded by scrolling floral ornament and enclosed within turquoise, minium, and gilt bands. The right-hand cartouche contains the inscription لا يمسه الا المطهرون تنزیل من رب العالمین کاتبه محمد صادق. The corresponding cartouche on the left contains the same text without the reference to the scribe, لا يمسه الا المطهرون تنزیل من رب العالمین.

Enclosing the central decorative composition and its multilayered framing system, the broad outer marginal border (ḥāshiya) extends along three sides of each page. It displays a dynamic reciprocal pattern of undulating, interlocking lobed cloud-bands, alternating between deep lapis lazuli blue fields decorated with delicate white-lead arabesque spirals (islimi), punctuated by vermilion accents, and burnished gold fields ornamented with symmetrical five-petalled rosettes in vermilion and white lead, accented by exceptionally fine lapis lazuli blue tendrils.

In contrast to the lavishly illuminated opening pages, the subsequent leaves feature a restrained, functional decorative programme without gold-leaf illumination. Each page contains a structured rectangular text block enclosed within a simple multiline framing system of fine, parallel rulings in minium, lapis lazuli blue and black ink. The text area is organised into regular horizontal registers separated by fine ruled lines, with each sūra introduced by a narrow, full-width rectangular heading panel defined by upper and lower rulings. The main text is arranged in uniform horizontal lines, bounded by the vertical rulings of the frame. The text block is further enclosed within a double-ruled decorative frame, while an additional single black decorative frame runs consistently along the outer margins.

bindingDesc.p: Brown leather binding, 19 × 30 cm, front + back cover, leather + pasteboard.
bindingDesc.decoNote: The exterior boards are decorated with blind-tooled rectangular frames formed by parallel ruled lines. A narrow fretwork border runs along the perimeter, with additional ruled compartments at the head and tail of the board.
bindingDesc.condition: The leather surface is extensively abraded and scuffed, with areas of surface loss and staining. The board edges and corners show pronounced wear consistent with age and handling.

history.acquisition: Donated to The Ferdowsi Library by Dr Caro Minasian in 1972.

recordHist.source: This record was created by Dr Mohammad Emami based on the information published in the Persian catalogue by Dr Ali Mir-Ansari (Catalogue of the Persian and Arabic Manuscripts in the Ferdowsi Library, Wadham College, University of Oxford (Minasian Collection), Tehran: Miras-e Maktoob, 2016), with further improvements.

availability.p: Entry to the Library is permitted upon presentation of a valid university ID card (for admissions procedures, please visit Wadham College Library, Persian Studies Section). Please Contact persian.library@wadham.ox.ac.ukfor further information on the availability of this manuscript.
